content.bridge_context: Building on Grade 6 narrative themes, this story introduces philosophical inquiry through a king's quest for wisdom.

units.title: The Nature of Wisdom
units.explanation: Wisdom isn't just knowing facts, but knowing how to act rightly in any situation.
units.dual_language_instruction: Reflect on what makes a person wise. / विचार करें कि किसी व्यक्ति को बुद्धिमान क्या बनाता है।

units.title: The Three Crucial Questions
units.explanation: The King asks: 1. What is the right time? 2. Who are the right people? 3. What is the most important thing to do?
units.dual_language_instruction: List the king's questions. / राजा के प्रश्नों की सूची बनाएं।
